feature: The Captions track sits under the picture tracks
summary: Captions now land on a track under V1 and over Audio, the way video.html lists Title, V1, V2, Captions, Audio. They are still drawn over the picture and over the title, wherever their row sits.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/captions-sit-under-the-picture-walk.json (also checked in an-editing-session-walk).

try.do: Open a recording with somebody talking and press Command 2 for Edit.
Press T, click low on the picture and type a title, then Command Return.
Click + under the track headers and choose Captions. Read the headers top to bottom: Title, V1, Captions with Words, Audio.
Choose File > Export, PNG, at a moment with a caption under the title: the caption plate sits over the title.
Drag the Captions header above Title: it stays there and the picture does not change.
Press Command Z: Captions goes back under V1.

evaluate: With Captions under V1, do you still find the captions quickly when you go looking for a line to fix?
Is it right that captions draw over a title even when the title's track is higher up the list?
Would you rather a dragged Captions track change what draws in front, the way picture tracks do?
While Add Captions listens, does its progress row read well sitting under V1 rather than at the top?
rough: The Words lane under the Captions track is not in video.html's timeline; it comes from the captions mock and was built by fix-a-caption-one-word-at-a-time-on-the-canvas-a.
Captions are the one track whose place in the list does not decide what draws in front. A title over the lower third now sits under the caption plate, as in the exported frame here.
The listening row that shows while Add Captions works now stands under the picture tracks too, but no picture here shows it: the sample is heard too fast to photograph.
